name: Find Templates by Specific Table
description: Query to find all templates that are applicable to a specific table name, with optional inclusion of universal templates
query:
query FindTemplatesByTable($input: FindTemplatesByTableInput!) {
  templatesByTable(input: $input) {
    id
    identifier
    name
    description
    queryText
    applicableTables
    tags
    complexityScore
    usageCount
    operationType
    isActive
    createdAt
    updatedAt
  }
}

input.description: Input for finding templates by table

tableName.description: Name of the table to search templates for

includeUniversal.description: Whether to include universal templates (applicable_tables is null)
